funded_lock: locks at start+$100 when EOD balance reaches start+$2,100 or when a payout is requested, whichever first
funded_consistency_effect: blocks payout until largest day <=35% of total profit
after_payout: winning-day count resets to zero; drawdown locked (lock triggered by payout request)
automation_conditions: bots allowed if: you prove sole ownership; no similar orders on other accounts; live video of you enabling the code on your own PC on request; not used at other firms; not HFT
python_order_route: No firm API. Candidate routes (all UNVERIFIED for this firm): (1) NinjaTrader 8 on own PC (NinjaScript strategy, or ATI fed by a local Python process) over the firm's Tradovate/Rithmic login; (2) Tradovate REST API: community posts say prop accounts have API access disabled; (3) Rithmic R|Protocol API: needs Rithmic dev kit + conformance approval; (4) paid third-party webhook bridges (TradersPost, PickMyTrade, CrossTrade). Tradeify brokers: Tradovate (NinjaTrader, TradingView) or Rithmic (Tradesea, Quantower, Sierra Chart, R|Trader) or WealthCharts
vps_allowed: login must not be via VPN/VPS; after normal login VPS may be used 'at your own risk'
min_hold_rule: funded only: payout needs >50% of trades AND >50% of profit from trades held >10 s (blocks payout, no fail)
unverified: DLL measured on realized or net-liq not stated
payout amount as share of profit not stated (only per-request cap)
whether a self-written Python program can reach Tradeify accounts (no firm API documented)
payout_buffer_note: QA 2026-10-28: $53,000 is the minimum balance to REQUEST, not a buffer; official example: $53,000 balance, $1,500 request leaves $51,500 (accounts bought before 2025-09-12: $52,100)
